deltas.title_id: PP Berlaku, PPh Final UMKM Kini Bukan untuk CV, PT, Firma, dan BUMDes
deltas.title_en: PP Now in Effect, MSME Final Income Tax No Longer Applies to CVs, PTs, Partnerships, and Village-Owned Enterprises
deltas.impact_note: Clients operating CVs, standard PTs, general partnerships, or BUMDes are immediately ineligible for the 0.5% MSME final PPh scheme and must revert to standard progressive or corporate income tax rates.
deltas.summary: Government Regulation 20/2026 restricts the 0.5% MSME final PPh scheme to individual taxpayers (WP OP), sole proprietor corporations (PT Perorangan), and cooperatives only. CVs, general partnerships (Firma), standard PTs, and BUMDes are explicitly excluded. Individual taxpayers and PT Perorangan with annual gross revenue up to Rp4.8 billion may now use the 0.5% rate indefinitely, removing the previous 7-year (WP OP) and 4-year (PT Perorangan) caps under PP 55/2022.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Government Regulation 20/2026 restricts the 0.5% MSME final PPh scheme to individual taxpayers, sole proprietor corporations, and cooperatives, explicitly excluding CVs, general partnerships, standard PTs, and BUMDes.

deltas.citation: PP 20/2026, Pasal 56 ayat (3) huruf a (Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 20 Tahun 2026)
deltas.title_id: Influencer dan Kreator Konten Tak Bisa Pakai PPh Final UMKM 0,5 Persen
deltas.title_en: Influencers and Content Creators Cannot Use the 0.5% MSME Final Income Tax Scheme
deltas.impact_note: Foreign clients in Indonesia earning income as influencers or content creators cannot apply the 0.5% MSME final PPh rate and must use standard individual income tax rates for that income stream.
deltas.summary: PP 20/2026 Article 56 paragraph (3) letter a explicitly excludes income from independent personal services — including influencers and content creators — from eligibility for the 0.5% MSME final PPh regime. This also extends to PT Perorangan entities established by individuals with specialized professional expertise (lawyers, accountants, doctors, notaries, athletes, teachers, agents, MLM sellers) where the services rendered are identical to those of the founding proprietor.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PP 20/2026 explicitly excludes income earned by individual taxpayers from independent personal services — including influencers and content creators — from eligibility for the simplified 0.5% MSME final PPh regime.

deltas.citation: PP 20/2026, Pasal 57 ayat (2) huruf e (Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 20 Tahun 2026)
deltas.title_id: Pemerintah Tutup Celah Firm Splitting pada Skema PPh Final UMKM
deltas.title_en: Government Closes Firm Splitting Loophole in MSME Final Income Tax Scheme
deltas.impact_note: Clients who split business revenue across multiple sole-proprietor entities to stay below the Rp4.8 billion threshold will now have all entities' revenues aggregated, potentially disqualifying all of them from the 0.5% MSME final PPh scheme.
deltas.summary: PP 20/2026 Article 57 paragraph (2) letter e introduces an aggregate gross revenue threshold of Rp4.8 billion covering an individual taxpayer and all their sole-proprietor entities combined. This prevents abuse of the MSME final PPh scheme through artificial business splitting (firm splitting). Clients with multiple sole-proprietor businesses must now assess combined revenue against the single Rp4.8 billion ceiling.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PP 20/2026 introduces an aggregate gross revenue threshold of Rp4.8 billion covering an individual taxpayer and all their sole-proprietor entities combined, preventing abuse of the MSME final PPh scheme through artificial business splitting.

deltas.title_id: Perhatian! Relaksasi Pelaporan SPT Tahunan Badan Berakhir Besok
deltas.title_en: Attention! Relaxation Period for Corporate Annual Tax Return Filing Ends Tomorrow
deltas.impact_note: Corporate taxpayer clients who have not yet filed their 2025 SPT Tahunan Badan must do so by end of day 2026-05-31 to avoid administrative penalties; the penalty-free window granted by KEP-71/PJ/2026 expires today.
deltas.summary: KEP-71/PJ/2026 granted corporate taxpayers a relaxation window to file their 2025 annual income tax returns (SPT Tahunan Badan) without administrative penalties. The deadline for this relaxation period expires on May 31, 2026. Corporate clients who miss this deadline will be subject to standard late-filing penalties under the General Tax Provisions Law.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: KEP-71/PJ/2026 grants corporate taxpayers a relaxation window to file their 2025 annual income tax returns (SPT Tahunan Badan) without administrative penalties, with the deadline expiring on May 31, 2026.

deltas.title_id: Resmi! WP OP dan PT Perorangan Kini Bisa Pakai Tarif 0,5 Persen Tanpa Batas Waktu
deltas.title_en: Official! Individual Taxpayers and Sole Proprietorship Companies Can Now Use the 0.5% Rate Indefinitely
deltas.impact_note: Clients who are individual taxpayers (WP OP) or PT Perorangan owners whose 7-year or 4-year MSME final PPh benefit period expired in 2024 or 2025 are eligible for reinstatement under transitional provisions of PP 20/2026.
deltas.summary: PP 20/2026 permanently extends the 0.5% final income tax rate for qualifying WP OP and PT Perorangan with annual gross revenue up to Rp4.8 billion, replacing the prior time-limited benefits under PP 55/2022 (7 years for WP OP, 4 years for PT Perorangan) and PP 23/2018. Transitional provisions cover taxpayers whose benefit periods expired in 2024-2025, allowing them to re-enter the scheme.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: The Indonesian government issued PP 20/2026, permanently extending the 0.5% final income tax rate for individual taxpayers (WP OP) and sole proprietorship corporations (PT Perorangan) with annual gross revenue up to Rp4.8 billion. Previously under PP 55/2022, the benefit was capped at 7 years for individuals and 4 years for PT Perorangan. Transitional provisions cover taxpayers whose periods expired in 2024-2025.

deltas.citation: PP 20/2026, Pasal 56 ayat (4), Pasal 57 ayat (2) (Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 20 Tahun 2026)
deltas.title_id: Tak Semua PT Perorangan Bisa Pakai PPh Final UMKM, Ini Kriterianya
deltas.title_en: Not All Sole Proprietorship Companies Can Use the UMKM Final Income Tax, Here Are the Criteria
deltas.impact_note: Foreign clients who converted to or established a PT Perorangan to access the 0.5% rate must verify their professional classification — if their PT Perorangan provides services identical to their own specialized expertise, they are excluded.
deltas.summary: Under PP 20/2026 Articles 56(4) and 57(2), PT Perorangan entities established by individuals with specialized professional expertise — including lawyers, accountants, doctors, notaries, influencers, athletes, teachers, agents, and MLM sellers — are excluded from the 0.5% final UMKM income tax if the entity provides services identical to those of the founding proprietor.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: PT Perorangan entities established by individuals with specialized professional expertise (lawyers, accountants, doctors, notaries, influencers, athletes, teachers, agents, MLM sellers) are excluded from the 0.5% final UMKM income tax if they provide services identical to those of their founding proprietor.

deltas.citation: Coretax DJP (sistem administrasi perpajakan Direktorat Jenderal Pajak)
deltas.title_id: Kantor Pajak Ajari Mahasiswa Soal Coretax dan Cara Lapor SPT Tahunan
deltas.title_en: Tax Office Educates Students on Coretax DJP System and Annual Tax Return Filing
deltas.impact_note: No immediate client action required; informational note that DJP is actively expanding Coretax DJP literacy, signaling continued rollout of the system for SPT filing.
deltas.summary: KPP Pratama Sidoarjo Utara conducted an educational session at Universitas Nahdlatul Ulama Sidoarjo to train students on the Coretax DJP system and SPT Tahunan submission procedures. Part of DJP's broader Coretax DJP rollout. No regulatory change announced.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: KPP Pratama Sidoarjo Utara held an educational session at Universitas Nahdlatul Ulama Sidoarjo teaching students how to use the Coretax DJP system and submit annual income tax returns (SPT Tahunan).
